boost_double_trigger.description: Every boost building triggers twice per round. Including the ones you build later.
boost_double_trigger.name: Productivity Drive

condition_dmg_bonus.description: Enemies standing on mountain, pond or forest tiles take {dmg_bonus_pct}% more damage.
condition_dmg_bonus.name: Fighting on Home Soil

mortar_slow.description: Every currently placed Mortar slows enemies by {slow_pct}% for {duration_seconds} seconds. Mortars built after this choice are not affected.
mortar_slow.name: Scorched Earth

move_time_cap.description: Moving a building never takes longer than {move_time_cap} round, no matter how far it travels.
move_time_cap.name: Rapid Deployment

musician_auto_level.description: Newly placed musicians - Flute Player, Harp Player, Trio - start {bonus_levels} level higher.
musician_auto_level.name: Military Entertainment

restock_lives.description: Refills back the full starting number of lives, right now.
restock_lives.name: Second Chance

stone_thrower_sync.description: Level up every Stone Thrower until they all share the same level as the highest one.
stone_thrower_sync.name: Military Doctrine

stormpriest_slow.description: Storm Priest lightning slows every enemy it damages by {slow_pct}% for {duration_seconds} seconds, including ones you build later.
stormpriest_slow.name: Cloud Seeding

thorns.description: Enemies get damaged on hit for {reflect_pct}% of the damage they deal.
thorns.name: Thorns

tile_discount.description: Unlocking new tiles costs {discount_pct}% less love.
tile_discount.name: Promised Land

tile_refund.description: Pays back every love you have spent on unlocking tiles so far.
tile_refund.name: Reparations

wall_cost_discount.description: Blockers and Wall Builders cost {cost_reduction_pct}% less to build and to upgrade.
wall_cost_discount.name: Fortification
